facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 11 February 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
